title: One Letter and One Week
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：opportunity　|　正文 383 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 opportunity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: When the letter came I was twenty-two and had one suit. It offered an ① opportunity to go, and to be paid for going, and it came with a date by which I had to answer. My grandfather, who had left school at eleven, read it twice and said the word as if weighing it: opportunity. He said there are two kinds: the ② opportunity of a lifetime, which arrives once and announces itself, and the one that arrives quietly and takes you, and that the difference is never clear at the time. He said ③ at the earliest opportunity I should write down what I wanted and then put the paper away for a week.

I did not put the paper away. I ④ took the opportunity to tell everyone in the house that I had been chosen, which is a thing I am still ashamed of, and I spent the week being congratulated for a decision I had not yet made. There was a ⑤ job opportunity at the end of it, a desk, and a salary my mother could not say out loud without laughing. My sister, who has never ⑥ missed an opportunity in her life, said that refusing would be a kind of vanity.

What stopped me was a sentence in the letter about the ⑦ opportunity for research in the second year, which turned out, on a second reading, to be open only to those who had not been sent abroad. I read it four times. In the language of the office it was nothing at all: a clause, a condition, a small opportunity. It was also, I now think, the only opportunity I have ever been certain about.

I wrote to decline on the Friday, ⑧ at the first opportunity, before I could change my mind, and I have spent twenty years being asked whether I ⑨ regret the opportunity. I do not. What I regret is the week of being congratulated, and that I have never since been so certain about anything.

My grandfather's distinction holds up. The desk, the salary and the abroad would have taken the research with them, and the research was the part that was mine. Equal ⑩ opportunity, as the letter used the phrase, meant an equal chance to be sent; it said nothing about an equal chance to stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 机会；时机（an opportunity to do / of doing）
B. n. （工作、升学的）机会；职位空缺（a job opportunity）
C. n. 千载难逢的机会；一生一次的良机（the opportunity of a lifetime）
D. 固定搭配：take the opportunity to do sth. 借机做某事
E. 固定搭配：miss / seize an opportunity 错过／抓住机会
F. 固定搭配：opportunity for (doing) sth. ……的机会
G. 固定搭配：at the earliest / first opportunity 尽早；一有机会
H. 固定搭配：equal opportunity 平等机会

items.q: It offered an opportunity to go
at the earliest opportunity I should write down
took the opportunity to tell everyone
There was a job opportunity at the end of it
has never missed an opportunity in her life
the opportunity for research in the second year
at the first opportunity, before I could change my mind
Equal opportunity, as the letter used the phrase

answers.why: an opportunity to do 意为“做某事的机会”，指信里提供的出国机会。
the opportunity of a lifetime 意为“一生一次的机会”，说它来时声势很大。
at the earliest opportunity 意为“尽早、一有机会就”，祖父催我尽快写下想法。
take the opportunity to do 意为“借机做某事”，我借机向全家宣布被选中。
a job opportunity 意为“一份工作机会、职位”，指信尾的岗位与薪水。
miss an opportunity 意为“错过机会”，说姐姐这辈子从不错过任何机会。
opportunity for (doing) sth. 意为“做某事的机会”，此处指第二年做研究的机会。
at the first opportunity 意为“一有机会（就）”，我赶在改变主意前写了回绝信。
regret the opportunity 即“后悔（放过）那个机会”，取“机会、时机”义。
equal opportunity 意为“平等机会”，信里用它指被派出去的机会人人均等。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这封信提供了一个走的机会，而且是有报酬的。（opportunity）

answers: The letter offered an opportunity to go, and to be paid for going.
My grandfather said there is only one opportunity of a lifetime.
He told me to write down what I wanted at the earliest opportunity.
I took the opportunity to tell everyone in the house that I had been chosen.
My sister has never missed an opportunity in her life.
The letter mentioned an opportunity for research in the second year.
